scope: Static source review of module dependency construction and app-layer imports; no test or build executed.

findings.prisma_facade: lib/prisma.ts lazily creates one global PrismaClient when first accessed; lib/modules/shared/db.ts provides DB types, not an application-wide composition root.

assessment: Composition is distributed across use cases and app-layer callers; there is no single application-wide assembly point visible in this review. This is architectural debt, not evidence by itself of a runtime failure or bundle-size regression. Existing architecture-boundary guard reports zero route imports of Prisma/services, but the 7 listed app/page/component files import module internals directly.
decision: Do not introduce a broad composition-root refactor in this audit step. Keep K04 partial and defer the refactor until a measured isolation/runtime need or a bounded use case justifies it; K21 local HTTP acceptance does not require this refactor.
limitations: Counts come from a bounded regex/source scan, not a TypeScript AST or runtime instrumentation.
No dynamic import graph, production bundle, container, or independent architectural review was evaluated.
This review does not prove that all 125 constructor sites are undesirable or should be replaced by dependency injection.
